q01.question: Which of the following statements regarding Makefiles are true (choose all that apply)?

responses.graph: Makefile rules specify the nodes in a directed acyclic graph.
responses.clean: A clean target is automatically provided by make.
responses.cflags: The CFLAGS variable is typically used during compilation.
responses.ldflags: The LDFLAGS variable is typically used during linking.
responses.at: The $@ variable refers to the target.
responses.less: The $< variable refers to all of the sources.

q02.question: Which of the following statements regarding the shared library (libstr.so) and the static library (libstr.a) is true (choose all that apply)?

responses.objects_same: The shared and static libraries had the same object files.
responses.objects_diff: The shared and static libraries had different object files.
responses.shared_smaller: The shared library was smaller than static library.
responses.static_smaller: The static library was smaller than shared library.
responses.linker_same: The shared and static libraries used the same linker.
responses.linker_diff: The shared and static libraries used different linkers.

q03.question: Which of the following statements regarding the dynamic executable (trit.dynamic) and the static executable (trit.static) is true (choose all that apply)?

responses.dyn_link_shared: The dynamic executable requires the shared library during linking.
responses.sta_link_shared: The static executable requires the shared library during linking.
responses.dyn_link_static: The dynamic executable requires the static library during linking.
responses.sta_link_static: The static executable requires the static library during linking.
responses.dyn_run_shared: The dynamic executable requires the shared library at run-time.
responses.sta_run_shared: The static executable requires the shared library at run-time.
responses.dyn_run_static: The dynamic executable requires the static library at run-time.
responses.sta_run_static: The static executable requires the static library at run-time.
responses.dyn_larger: The dynamic executable is larger than static executable.
responses.sta_larger: The static executable is larger than dynamic executable.

q04.question: To execute the dynamic executable (trit.dynamic), we need to set the ____ environmental variable to include the folder that contains the ____ library.
